fields.name: imu_header_stamp
fields.vehicle_driver_source: src/sensor_drivers/livox_ros_driver2/src/lddc.cpp:570-603 and :758-780 assign ROS 2 header.stamp from cur_node_->now(); the commented path used pkg/imu hardware timestamps
fields.super_lio_source: Super-LIO ROSWrapper.cpp:347-349 consumes header.stamp directly through stampToSec()
fields.risk: ROS stamp encoding is identical, but the vehicle driver source proves the stamp is system/arrival time rather than a verified hardware measurement time; deskew equivalence remains unproven

fields.name: imu_linear_acceleration_scale
fields.reason: driver/bag unit contract is not proven; neither retaining nor removing the factor is safe
fields.super_lio_source: Super-LIO ROSWrapper.cpp:350-352 copies sensor_msgs/Imu.linear_acceleration directly into IMUData.acc
fields.risk: Both parser/driver paths are raw copies, while the locked FAST-LIO2 callback applies an unexplained factor of 10.0; no source file proves whether the device values are m/s^2, scaled counts, or another convention

fields.name: imu_angular_velocity
fields.risk: The copy path is source-verified, but ROS rad/s and the device's actual scale still require a stationary IMU/runtime or raw bag check

fields.name: livox_offset_time
fields.vehicle_fastlio: offset_time * 1e-6 stored as ms, then /1000 for cloud end
fields.reason: both use driver arrival-time header; hardware timebase relationship is unverified
fields.source: Super-LIO ROSWrapper.cpp:419-441; vehicle utils.cpp:2-27; vehicle lio_node.cpp:482-513
fields.vehicle_driver_source: src/sensor_drivers/livox_ros_driver2/src/lddc.cpp:614-626 stores points[i].offset_time - pkg.base_time in uint32 CustomPoint.offset_time
fields.super_lio_source: Super-LIO ROSWrapper.cpp:426-439 multiplies CustomPoint.offset_time by 1e-9 and adds the last accepted offset to header.stamp
fields.source_unit_claim: The driver preserves an SDK offset delta in a uint32 field and Super-LIO consumes that field as nanoseconds; SDK/hardware clock and packet-unit proof are still required
fields.risk: The driver deliberately stamps the message with cur_node_->now() and rewrites timebase, so a numerically matching offset unit does not establish hardware-time deskew

fields.name: livox_filter
fields.reason: vehicle packet-stride semantics need the actual MID360 stream or bag

fields.name: lidar_imu_synchronization
fields.super_lio: consumes imu_time <= lidar_end_time; no point sort before last offset
fields.reason: boundary and non-monotonic offset behavior require replay evidence

fields.name: odom_pose_and_twist
fields.super_lio: world frame, imu child, world velocity; patched angular velocity and source covariance
fields.vehicle_fastlio: world frame, base child, body velocity
fields.reason: measured IMU-to-base transform and lever-arm covariance are absent

fields.name: height_and_obstacle_clouds
fields.super_lio: world cloud only; no equivalent vehicle height/obstacle filters
fields.vehicle_fastlio: body/world height window and separate obstacle window
fields.reason: target local ground/obstacle adapter must preserve locked windows without guessing

fields.name: health
fields.super_lio: UNKNOWN source health; no degeneracy equivalent
fields.vehicle_fastlio: degeneracy eigenvalue/condition metric and health aggregator
fields.reason: Super-LIO cannot be mapped to FAST-LIO2 degeneracy without a validated formula
